ideas.title: Investigation into Minnesota Immigration Enforcement
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent DOJ investigation into Governor Tim Walz and Mayor Jacob Frey, focusing on the allegations of obstruction of federal law enforcement efforts.
questions: What are the specific allegations against Governor Walz and Mayor Frey?
How have they responded to the investigation?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to shed light on the complex issues surrounding immigration enforcement and the role of state and local governments in enforcing federal laws. As an investigator, I believe that it is essential to follow the money and examine the potential motivations behind the actions of Governor Walz and Mayor Frey.
